identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-10A][multi-agent][proof] Run live distributed Codex workcell end to end

values.goal: Prepare the exact contracts for one real distributed Codex workcell proof spanning admitted planning, bounded context handoff, at least two disjoint writable shards, live dashboard observations, review, convergence, serialized integration, closeout, and a fair bounded single-agent comparison.
values.required_outcome: After every implementation dependency is terminal, a retained exact-revision packet proves the complete supported distributed workcell with real Codex tasks; fixtures, mocks, screenshots, library tests, and prose alone cannot satisfy the issue.
declared_scope: issue-local typed lifecycle, preparation, validation, review, and evidence records
future bounded live proof orchestration using already reviewed #5499, #5498, #5500, and #5502 interfaces
real two-or-more-shard task, claim, branch, worktree, protected-path, context, output, review, convergence, integration, and closeout evidence
timing, coordination overhead, failure, retry, and equivalent bounded single-agent baseline comparison
authority_boundary: #5499 owns issue-graph planning and admitted task/shard plans
#5498 owns Codex task creation, messaging, handoff, context, and output transport
#5500 owns read-only dashboard and blackboard projection
#5502 owns output convergence and deterministic integrate, replan, or blocked decisions
#5501 owns only the integrated live proof packet and does not gain autonomous review, publication, merge, or closeout authority
operator_constraints: Use installed typed C-SDLC v2 binaries and current-registry semantic card operations only
Keep root main untouched; all tracked #5501 preparation stays in /Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5501
Preparation only: no live task execution, product implementation, PR, publication, merge, Runtime v2, AWS, raw gh, credentials, provider calls, paid services, or hidden network authority

Do not execute the live workcell until #5349, #5499, #5498, #5500, and #5502 have live merged heads ancestral to the execution revision; typed closeout and retained receipts are audit-only signals, not readiness blockers
Future proof requires at least two real writable Codex shards with distinct issue claims, branches, worktrees, and disjoint protected paths
Fixture-only, mock-only, prose-only, screenshot-only, and library-only evidence never counts as the live proof
One bounded review immediately before PR is required by operator policy; do not add preparation review churn
